editorial:
When the White House falls to a bold terrorist attack, you watch a disgraced former guard named Mike Banning fight his way back into the building to save the President. The story moves fast, with loud action, tense standoffs, and a hero who knows every hallway. You feel the pressure as the national security team tries to make big choices from outside while Banning works alone inside. It is a straightforward action thriller that wants to keep you on the edge of your seat, not slow you down with deep drama.

The action scenes are big and easy to follow, and Gerard Butler gives Banning a tough, stubborn energy that fits the movie well. Some moments feel over the top, and the villains can be a little cartoonish, but the pacing rarely drags. If you want a loud, simple rescue story with plenty of fights and explosions, this is a fun pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Banning reaches the President and stops the terrorist leader from launching a nuclear attack. He fights through the last guards, kills the mastermind, and rescues the President before the missiles can fire. The White House is damaged but saved, and Banning proves he still belongs on the protection team. The movie ends with him back in good standing, ready for duty again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves loud action movies and rescue stories.
